authority_basis.claim: CORP-A requires one accepted critical-asset schedule for the complete asset denominator.
CORP-A covers asset inventory, provenance, licensing, trademark disposition, counsel-reviewed assignment, and corporate acceptance.
Issue #482 is bounded to the CORP-A schedule and redacted custody evidence paths.
